text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle

g.text: NodeTrix: inspect the links retained by the similarity threshold
Teal = similarity meets threshold; white = below threshold. Gray diagonal = self-pair, excluded.
Each undirected link appears twice. Row labels give within-group degree. Groups depend on threshold and modularity.
